articles.title: Android 會自動將電話號碼同步　一機多個帳戶則會全部加入號碼資料
articles.summary: Google 嘅 Android 手機會自動將電話號碼加入同一部手機嘅所有帳戶，想閂返要自己去設定度操作。

levels.text: Google 的 Android 手機會自動驗證你嘅電話號碼，然後將個號碼加入同一部手機上面嘅所有帳戶。就算你本來想分開用唔同帳戶，佢哋都會自動連埋電話號碼。這個設定喺今年9月已經開始，不過好多人依家先至發現。你可以去手機設定度閂咗佢，但係舊有嘅連結要自己刪除。
levels.text_en: Google's Android phones automatically verify your phone number, then add that number to all accounts on the same phone. Even if you originally wanted to keep different accounts separate, they will automatically get linked with the phone number. This setting has been active since September this year, but many people are only discovering it now. You can go to phone settings to turn it off, but you have to manually delete the old existing links.

levels.text: Google 的 Android 手機會自動驗證手機上的電話號碼，並把這個號碼加到同一部手機登入的所有 Google 帳戶，包括工作帳戶和其他副帳戶。這個安排早在2025年9月已經推出，但很多用戶最近收到驗證通知郵件才發現。用戶可以在手機設定中找到「電話號碼驗證」並關閉自動驗證，不過已經連結的舊資料不會自動刪除，需要自己到帳戶中逐一移除。
levels.text_en: Google's Android phones automatically verify the phone number on the device and add this number to all Google accounts logged in on the same phone, including work accounts and other secondary accounts. This arrangement was already rolled out back in September 2025, but many users only discovered it recently after receiving a verification notification email. Users can find "Phone number verification" in phone settings and turn off automatic verification, but already-linked old data won't be automatically deleted — users need to go into their accounts and remove it one by one.

levels.text:
最近有媒體發現，Google 的 Android 手機會預設自動驗證裝置上的電話號碼，並將號碼加入同一部手機登入的所有 Google 帳戶，連工作帳戶及其他副帳戶亦包括在內。其實這項安排早於 2025 年 9 月已列入 Google Play 服務更新，但不少用戶直到最近收到驗證通知電郵，才發現原本分開使用的帳戶已連結同一電話號碼。

Google 官方說明文件確認，「電話號碼驗證」（Phone number verification）預設開啟。只要功能仍然啟用，除了當時已登入的帳戶，其後新增的 Google 帳戶亦會自動加入裝置上的電話號碼，手機日後加入其他電話號碼，新號碼同樣會連結至已登入帳戶。

2025 年已開始自動驗證　近日再成話題

Google 於 2025 年 9 月 8 日公布的 Google Play services v25.35 更新紀錄，明確列出手機在設定期間會自動進行電話號碼驗證。有媒體指出，Google 在 2025 年 8 月至 10 月之間修改支援文件，加入預設啟用以及涵蓋所有帳戶的說明。近日有 Reddit 用戶表示，未經主動操作便收到來自 noreply-phone-verification@google.com 的驗證完成通知，引起外界留意。

Google 解釋，已驗證的電話號碼可用於帳戶登入及復原、尋找或遙距鎖定遺失手機、RCS 通訊和 Quick Share 等功能。Google 及流動網絡營運商亦會定期重新驗證號碼，過程可能產生電訊費用。官方文件沒有進一步解釋，為何這些用途必須令同一部手機上的所有帳戶共用電話號碼。

對於在同一部手機分開使用私人、工作或其他 Google 帳戶的用戶，這項預設安排可能與原本希望保持帳戶資料分隔的做法不同。不過，號碼加入帳戶並不代表該號碼會自動公開予其他人，亦未有證據證明這次自動連結必然用於廣告定向。

可於 Android 設定關閉　舊有連結要自行刪除

若不希望日後再自動連結電話號碼，可開啟 Android 手機「設定」，進入「Google」或「Google 服務與偏好設定」，選擇「所有服務」（All services），在「私隱與保安」下找到「電話號碼驗證」（Phone number verification），然後關閉「自動驗證電話號碼」（Verify phone numbers automatically）。實際選單名稱可能因手機品牌及系統語言而異。

關閉開關只會阻止日後自動驗證及加入號碼，並不會刪除已連結的資料。用戶須逐一登入需要檢查的 Google 帳戶，在「個人資料」（Personal info）下開啟「聯絡資料」及「電話」，移除不希望保留的號碼。若號碼同時用於兩步驗證、復原電話或其他 Google 服務，還應檢查相關設定，刪除之前先確保帳戶有其他可用的登入及復原方式。

由於 Google 將電話號碼驗證用於部分通訊及安全功能，停用後可能影響 RCS 訊息啟用或快速復原帳戶等體驗。有個別用戶表示，曾遇到關閉後設定自行重新啟用的情況，但現時不能確定是否普遍。用戶可以稍後再次檢查開關狀態。
levels.text_en:
Media recently discovered that Google's Android phones automatically verify the phone number on a device by default, and add that number to all Google accounts logged in on the same phone — including work accounts and other secondary accounts. In fact, this arrangement was already included in a Google Play services update back in September 2025, but many users only discovered — after recently receiving verification notification emails — that accounts they had kept separate were now linked to the same phone number.

Google's official support documentation confirms that "Phone number verification" is enabled by default. As long as the feature remains enabled, not only accounts that were already logged in at the time, but also any Google accounts added afterward will automatically have the device's phone number added to them; if the phone later adds other phone numbers, those new numbers will likewise be linked to the logged-in accounts.

Automatic verification began in 2025, recently became a hot topic again

Google's Google Play services v25.35 update log, published on September 8, 2025, explicitly states that phones will automatically perform phone number verification during setup. Media reports point out that between August and October 2025, Google modified its support documentation to add explanations about default activation and coverage of all accounts. Recently, a Reddit user said they received a verification completion notification from noreply-phone-verification@google.com without taking any initiative, which drew public attention.

Google explains that verified phone numbers can be used for account login and recovery, finding or remotely locking a lost phone, RCS messaging, Quick Share, and other features. Google and mobile network operators also periodically re-verify numbers, a process that may incur telecom charges. The official documentation does not further explain why these uses require all accounts on the same phone to share the same phone number.

For users who separately use private, work, or other Google accounts on the same phone, this default arrangement may conflict with their original intention of keeping account data separate. However, adding a number to an account does not mean the number is automatically made public to others, and there is no evidence that this automatic linking is necessarily used for ad targeting.

Can be turned off in Android settings; old links must be deleted manually

If you don't want your phone number to be automatically linked in the future, you can open your Android phone's "Settings," go to "Google" or "Google services & preferences," select "All services," find "Phone number verification" under "Privacy & security," and then turn off "Verify phone numbers automatically." The actual menu names may vary depending on phone brand and system language.

Turning off the switch only prevents future automatic verification and addition of numbers — it does not delete already-linked data. Users must log into each Google account that needs checking individually, go to "Contact info" and "Phone" under "Personal info," and remove any numbers they don't want to keep. If a number is also used for two-step verification, recovery phone, or other Google services, users should also check the relevant settings, and before deleting, make sure the account has other available ways to log in and recover.

Since Google uses phone number verification for some communication and security features, disabling it may affect experiences like RCS message activation or quick account recovery. Some individual users have reported that the setting re-enabled itself after being turned off, though it's currently unclear whether this is a widespread issue. Users may want to check the switch status again later.

articles.summary_en: This article explains a recently-noticed Android/Google behavior: phones automatically verify the device's phone number and link it to all Google accounts signed in on that phone, including work and secondary accounts, raising privacy concerns about account separation.

articles.title: 超強颱風薔琵影響　多班來往香港及台灣航班取消
articles.summary: 超強颱風薔琵逼近台灣，好多香港同台灣嘅航班都取消咗。

levels.text: 超強颱風薔琵逼近台灣，很多航班取消了。香港航空話，星期五有六班香港去台北嘅機要取消。已經訂飛嘅乘客可以免費改期或退票。薔琵仍然逼近上海，現在航班正常，但週末班機可能延誤或取消。長榮航空有十四班香港同台灣嘅機喺五、六取消。中華航空話，明日有十班香港台北同三班香港高雄嘅機取消。
levels.text_en: Super Typhoon Tsulphi is approaching Taiwan, and many flights have been cancelled. Hong Kong Airlines says six Hong Kong-to-Taipei flights on Friday will be cancelled. Passengers who already booked flights can change their dates for free or get refunds. Tsulphi is also approaching Shanghai; flights there are currently normal, but weekend flights may be delayed or cancelled. EVA Air has cancelled fourteen Hong Kong-Taiwan flights on Friday and Saturday. China Airlines says tomorrow ten Hong Kong-Taipei flights and three Hong Kong-Kaohsiung flights will be cancelled.

levels.text: 超強颱風薔琵逼近台灣，多間航空公司調整了航班。香港航空表示，星期五有六班來往香港和台北的航班取消。已經訂票的乘客可以免費更改日期或者退票。薔琵同時逼近上海浦東，目前航班正常，但星期六日的航班可能延誤或取消。長榮航空表示，星期五及星期六共有十四班來往香港和台灣的航班取消，乘客出發前應先查看網站。中華航空表示，明天有十班來往香港和台北的航班，以及三班香港和高雄的航班取消。
levels.text_en: Super Typhoon Tsulphi is approaching Taiwan, and several airlines have adjusted their flights. Hong Kong Airlines says six flights between Hong Kong and Taipei on Friday will be cancelled. Passengers who already booked tickets can change dates for free or get refunds. Tsulphi is also approaching Shanghai Pudong; flights there are currently normal, but flights on Saturday and Sunday may be delayed or cancelled. EVA Air says a total of fourteen flights between Hong Kong and Taiwan on Friday and Saturday will be cancelled, and passengers should check the website before departure. China Airlines says tomorrow ten flights between Hong Kong and Taipei, as well as three flights between Hong Kong and Kaohsiung, will be cancelled.

levels.text: 受超強颱風「薔琵」迫近台灣影響，多間航空公司調整航班服務。 香港航空宣布，周五6班來往香港至台北的航班將取消，已豁免受影響航班之重新訂位或更改航點或退票的手續費用，措施僅適用於已獲取確認機位之機票。另外，颱風薔琵亦正接近上海浦東，目前往返香港與上海浦東的航班運作正常，但預料周六及周日的航班可能受到延誤或取消。 長榮航空周五及周六往來香港及台灣的14個航班服務將取消，建議旅客在前往機場之前，先行查閱航空公司網站，取得最新航班消息。 中華航空宣布，明日有10班來回香港和台北的航班，以及3班香港及高雄的航班取消。
levels.text_en: Due to the approach of Super Typhoon Tsulphi toward Taiwan, several airlines have adjusted their flight services. Hong Kong Airlines announced that six flights between Hong Kong and Taipei on Friday will be cancelled, and has waived rebooking, destination-change, or refund fees for affected flights—this measure applies only to tickets with confirmed seats. In addition, Typhoon Tsulphi is also approaching Shanghai Pudong; flights between Hong Kong and Shanghai Pudong are currently operating normally, but flights on Saturday and Sunday are expected to possibly be delayed or cancelled. EVA Air's 14 flights between Hong Kong and Taiwan on Friday and Saturday will be cancelled; travelers are advised to check the airline's website for the latest flight information before heading to the airport. China Airlines announced that tomorrow there will be 10 round-trip flights between Hong Kong and Taipei, as well as 3 flights between Hong Kong and Kaohsiung, cancelled.

articles.summary_en: A super typhoon named Tsulphi is approaching Taiwan, causing airlines to cancel or adjust flights between Hong Kong, Taipei, Kaohsiung, and Shanghai Pudong.

articles.title: 害怕心臟二次開刀？「經導管瓣中瓣手術」免開胸，高齡瓣膜退化患者的新救星！
articles.summary: 新式經導管手術唔使開胸都可以幫高齡病人換心臟瓣膜，而且而家健保都有得資助。

levels.text: 心臟嘅瓣膜用耐咗會壞，老人家驚再開胸做手術。現在有種新手術，不用開胸，由大髀度放條喉入去換瓣膜。手術好快，傷口細，恢復得快，佢哋好快可以出院。張先生82歲，做咗呢個手術之後，一個星期就出院了。健保而家都有資助，等高齡病人可以安心做手術。
levels.text_en: Heart valves wear out and go bad after a long time, and old people are afraid to have their chest opened again for surgery. Now there's a new kind of surgery that doesn't require opening the chest — doctors insert a tube through the thigh to replace the valve. The surgery is quick, the wound is small, recovery is fast, and patients can leave the hospital quickly. Mr. Chang, 82 years old, left the hospital just one week after having this surgery. Health insurance now also provides subsidies, so elderly patients can feel more at ease about having the surgery.

levels.text: 許多高齡病人的心臟生物瓣膜用久了會老化損壞，需要再次手術更換。但很多人害怕再次開胸，因此猶豫不決。現在有一種新技術，叫做經導管瓣中瓣手術。醫生從大腿的血管放入導管，把新的瓣膜放進舊瓣膜的位置，不用開胸，也不用停止心臟跳動。手術時間短，傷口很小，病人很快就能出院，恢復也比較快。林口長庚醫院的陳紹緯教授指出，有位82歲的張先生做完這個手術，一個星期後就順利出院。現在健保已經把符合條件的高風險病人納入給付範圍，讓更多年長病人有機會接受這種手術。
levels.text_en: Many elderly patients' biological heart valves wear out and get damaged over time, requiring another surgery to replace them. But many people are afraid of having their chest opened again, so they hesitate. Now there is a new technique called transcatheter valve-in-valve surgery. Doctors insert a catheter through a blood vessel in the thigh and place the new valve into the position of the old valve, without opening the chest and without stopping the heart. The surgery takes less time, the wound is very small, and patients can leave the hospital quickly, with faster recovery as well. Professor Chen Shao-wei of Linkou Chang Gung Hospital pointed out that an 82-year-old patient, Mr. Chang, successfully left the hospital one week after this surgery. Now, National Health Insurance has included eligible high-risk patients under coverage, giving more elderly patients the chance to receive this kind of surgery.

生物瓣膜退化卻害怕二次開胸？「經導管瓣中瓣手術」讓患者免開胸、免停心跳即可置換新瓣膜。這項微創技術傷口小、恢復快，更獲健保條件給付，為高齡心臟病患帶來全新曙光。

「高齡82歲的張先生在10年前曾因感染性心內膜炎導致兩個心臟瓣膜損壞，而接受傳統開胸手術，在經過一段時間的細心照顧後順利出院。」林口長庚醫院胸腔及心臟血管外科系主任兼心臟血管外科主任陳紹緯教授表示，「大約在2年前，患者的人工瓣膜退化，需要再次手術。因為年紀較大，患者和家屬都相當猶豫。不過在經過詳細討論後，患者決定接受經導管瓣中瓣手術。」

經導管瓣中瓣手術是由鼠蹊部置入導管，在先進影像系統的導引下延伸至主動脈瓣或二尖瓣的位置，然後展開新的人工瓣膜。陳紹緯教授指出，手術過程相當順利，全程沒有插管、沒有開胸、沒有劇烈痛感，僅一個禮拜就順利出院，目前狀況穩定，持續在門診追蹤治療。

陳紹緯教授表示，隨著醫療科技進步，高齡或高風險患者可以透過微創導管方式進行經導管瓣中瓣手術，不僅傷口小、手術時間短、降低手術風險，也大幅縮短恢復時間，讓高齡患者能安心接受手術。近期中央健康保險署已將符合條件的高危險病人納入健保給付，對患者是一大福音。

-----廣告，請繼續往下閱讀-----

生物瓣膜的好處與痛點

臨床上，許多高齡患者因為主動脈瓣或二尖瓣狹窄、逆流等問題，接受人工生物瓣膜置換手術。陳紹緯教授指出，選擇由豬或牛的心臟組織製成的生物瓣膜，好處是不必因為瓣膜因素終身服用抗凝血劑，但生物瓣膜就像是高活動性的「門板」，在歷經數千萬次的心臟跳動開闔後，會隨時間逐漸出現老化、鈣化、破損或變形，導致瓣膜狹窄或嚴重逆流。

當這些患者的年紀越來越大，面臨瓣膜損壞需要二次手術時，常會讓人相當擔憂。陳紹緯教授解釋，因為傳統的外科手術方式，必須重新打開胸腔，不僅要面對前次手術留下的嚴重組織沾黏，還要使用人工心肺機讓心臟停止跳動來進行心臟手術。術後常面臨長期無法拔管、傷口癒合不良、甚至併發多重器官衰竭的危險。導致許多高齡患者與家屬一聽到「要再開一次胸」就放棄治療。

陳紹緯教授指出，針對生物瓣膜老化的痛點，現代醫學發展出「經導管瓣中瓣手術」（Valve-in-valve），此手術無需開胸、不必讓心臟停止跳動，醫師會經由導管將新的瓣膜精準置入舊的生物瓣膜支架內，撐開已失效的瓣葉來完成置換，是高齡、虛弱患者的福音。

經導管瓣中瓣手術解析：主動脈瓣與二尖瓣

經導管瓣中瓣手術的發展，徹底改寫了生物瓣膜老化患者的治療方式。這項技術適用於「主動脈瓣」與「二尖瓣」這兩個重要的心臟瓣膜。陳紹緯教授說明，由於原先主動脈瓣的框架結構相對固定，且血管通路較直，瓣中瓣手術技術發展已相當成熟。然而，當病灶位於「二尖瓣」時，瓣中瓣手術的難度便會大幅攀升，必須仰賴技術精良的心臟團隊。

-----廣告，請繼續往下閱讀-----

二尖瓣位於左心房與左心室之間，是控制左心室將血液送往全身的重要關卡。當原本置換的二尖瓣生物瓣膜老化損壞、關不緊時，會導致左心室收縮時的血液大量逆流回左心房，造成左心房壓力過高、肺部鬱血；當生物瓣膜老化、打不開時，會阻礙血液流入左心室，造成肺部鬱血。患者會出現走幾步路就喘不過氣、無法平躺、嚴重下肢水腫等典型的左心衰竭症狀。在進行經導管二尖瓣瓣中瓣手術時，由於二尖瓣與左心室出口相鄰，必須精準定位。

此外，經導管二尖瓣瓣中瓣手術的運送路徑通常較為曲折。陳紹緯教授說明，進行經導管二尖瓣瓣中瓣手術時，醫師通常會從股靜脈導入導管，在先進影像系統的導引下，穿過心房中隔進入左心房，再將新瓣膜精準套入舊的二尖瓣膜框架內。這需要極為精準的影像導引與純熟的團隊技術，才能確保新瓣膜正常運作且不影響周邊主動脈出口結構。

免除開胸、傷口極小的經導管瓣中瓣微創手術，對高齡病患而言具有無可取代的優勢。為了減輕經濟負擔，中央健康保險署已將「經導管二尖瓣瓣中瓣手術」正式納入健保的「有條件給付」範圍。陳紹緯教授指出，健保署會根據客觀的風險評分系統進行嚴謹評估，若高齡患者的身體狀況符合標準，便可獲得部分給付的資格，讓許多因手術風險而猶豫的患者，有機會接受經導管瓣中瓣微創手術。

陳紹緯教授提醒，每位患者的心臟構造與整體風險不同，切勿盲目進行「點菜式」醫療，應與兼具傳統外科、微創內視鏡與經導管治療能力的醫療團隊充分討論，量身打造適合的治療計畫！

Written by the Care Online editorial team.

This article is reprinted from Care Online's "Afraid of a second heart surgery? 'Transcatheter valve-in-valve surgery' avoids open-chest surgery, offering new hope for elderly patients with degenerated valves!" Friends who like this article are welcome to subscribe to and support Care Online.

Join Care Online's official LINE account to not miss any health information.

Afraid of a second open-chest surgery due to a degenerated bioprosthetic valve? "Transcatheter valve-in-valve surgery" allows patients to replace their valve without opening the chest and without stopping the heart. This minimally invasive technique has a small wound and fast recovery, and is now covered under certain conditions by National Health Insurance, bringing new hope to elderly heart disease patients.

"82-year-old Mr. Chang suffered damage to two heart valves 10 years ago due to infective endocarditis, and underwent traditional open-chest surgery. After a period of careful care, he was successfully discharged," said Professor Chen Shao-wei, director of the Division of Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgery and director of Cardiovascular Surgery at Linkou Chang Gung Memorial Hospital. "About two years ago, the patient's artificial valve had degenerated and needed another surgery. Because of his advanced age, the patient and his family were quite hesitant. However, after detailed discussion, the patient decided to undergo transcatheter valve-in-valve surgery."

In transcatheter valve-in-valve surgery, a catheter is inserted through the groin and, guided by an advanced imaging system, extended to the position of the aortic valve or mitral valve, where a new artificial valve is then deployed. Professor Chen pointed out that the surgery went very smoothly — there was no intubation, no chest opening, and no severe pain throughout, and the patient was discharged successfully after just one week. He is currently stable and continuing follow-up treatment as an outpatient.

Professor Chen stated that with advances in medical technology, elderly or high-risk patients can undergo transcatheter valve-in-valve surgery via a minimally invasive catheter approach. This not only results in a smaller wound, shorter surgery time, and reduced surgical risk, but also greatly shortens recovery time, allowing elderly patients to undergo surgery with greater peace of mind. Recently, the National Health Insurance Administration has included eligible high-risk patients under NHI coverage, which is great news for patients.

[Advertisement, please continue reading below]

The benefits and pain points of biological valves

Clinically, many elderly patients undergo artificial bioprosthetic valve replacement surgery due to problems such as aortic or mitral valve stenosis or regurgitation. Professor Chen pointed out that choosing a bioprosthetic valve made from pig or cow heart tissue has the benefit of not requiring lifelong anticoagulant medication because of the valve. However, a bioprosthetic valve is like a highly active "door panel" — after tens of millions of heart beats opening and closing it, it will gradually age, calcify, become damaged, or deform over time, leading to valve stenosis or severe regurgitation.

As these patients get older and face valve damage requiring a second surgery, it often causes great worry. Professor Chen explained that with traditional surgical methods, the chest must be reopened, which not only means dealing with severe tissue adhesions left from the previous surgery, but also requires using a heart-lung machine to stop the heart in order to perform the surgery. After surgery, patients often face prolonged inability to remove tubes, poor wound healing, and even the danger of multiple organ failure. As a result, many elderly patients and their families give up on treatment as soon as they hear "the chest needs to be opened again."

Professor Chen pointed out that to address the pain point of bioprosthetic valve aging, modern medicine has developed "transcatheter valve-in-valve surgery," which requires no chest opening and no stopping of the heart. The doctor precisely places a new valve into the old bioprosthetic valve's stent via catheter, expanding the failed valve leaflets to complete the replacement — a blessing for elderly, frail patients.

Analysis of transcatheter valve-in-valve surgery: the aortic valve and the mitral valve

The development of transcatheter valve-in-valve surgery has completely changed the treatment approach for patients with aging bioprosthetic valves. This technique applies to two important heart valves: the "aortic valve" and the "mitral valve." Professor Chen explained that because the original aortic valve's frame structure is relatively fixed and the vascular pathway is more direct, the valve-in-valve technique for it is already quite mature. However, when the problem is located at the "mitral valve," the difficulty of the valve-in-valve surgery increases significantly, requiring a highly skilled cardiac team.

[Advertisement, please continue reading below]

The mitral valve is located between the left atrium and left ventricle, and is an important gateway controlling the left ventricle's pumping of blood to the whole body. When the originally replaced mitral bioprosthetic valve ages, becomes damaged, and doesn't close properly, it causes a large amount of blood to flow back into the left atrium when the left ventricle contracts, leading to excessively high left atrial pressure and pulmonary congestion; when the bioprosthetic valve ages and can't open properly, it obstructs blood flow into the left ventricle, also causing pulmonary congestion. Patients will show typical symptoms of left heart failure, such as shortness of breath after walking just a few steps, inability to lie flat, and severe lower limb edema. When performing transcatheter mitral valve-in-valve surgery, because the mitral valve is adjacent to the left ventricular outlet, precise positioning is essential.

In addition, the delivery pathway for transcatheter mitral valve-in-valve surgery is usually more winding. Professor Chen explained that when performing this surgery, doctors usually introduce the catheter through the femoral vein, and under the guidance of an advanced imaging system, pass through the atrial septum into the left atrium, then precisely fit the new valve into the frame of the old mitral valve. This requires extremely precise image guidance and a highly skilled team to ensure that the new valve functions normally without affecting the surrounding aortic outlet structure.

The minimally invasive transcatheter valve-in-valve surgery, which avoids chest opening and has an extremely small wound, offers irreplaceable advantages for elderly patients. To ease the financial burden, the National Health Insurance Administration has officially included "transcatheter mitral valve-in-valve surgery" under NHI's "conditional coverage" scope. Professor Chen pointed out that the NHI Administration conducts rigorous assessments based on an objective risk scoring system, and if an elderly patient's physical condition meets the criteria, they can qualify for partial coverage, giving many patients who have hesitated due to surgical risk the opportunity to receive this minimally invasive valve-in-valve surgery.

Professor Chen reminds patients that each patient's heart structure and overall risk are different, and one should not blindly pursue an 'à la carte' approach to treatment. Patients should fully discuss with a medical team capable of traditional surgery, minimally invasive endoscopy, and transcatheter treatment, in order to design a tailored treatment plan!

articles.title: 機電署巡查其他升降機承辦商工程　未有出現無安裝門框組件情況
articles.summary: 機電工程署查咗好多部電梯，都冇再見到漏裝門框嘅情況，仲話會盡快幫受影響嘅樓宇裝好門框。

levels.text: 機電工程署查咗好多部電梯，都冇再見到漏裝門框嘅情況。他們話，已經檢查5個屋苑同50幢樓，冇發現同樣問題。佢哋話會盡快幫受影響嘅樓宇裝好門框。
levels.text_en: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department checked many lifts and did not find any more cases of missing door frames. They said they have inspected 5 housing estates and 50 buildings, and found no similar problems. They said they will install door frames for the affected buildings as soon as possible.

levels.text: 機電工程署因為早前「臺日」更換電梯時沒有安裝門框組件，於是巡查其他升降機承辦商的工程。目前已經檢查了5個屋苑共6幢樓宇，加上50幢獨立大廈，全部都沒有出現漏裝門框的情況。署方會繼續檢查承辦商交來的聲明書，並抽查工程。因為至今所有漏裝門框的個案都與「臺日」有關，他們會盡快為受影響的樓宇裝上門框。
levels.text_en: Because the contractor 'Toi Yat' previously failed to install door frame components when replacing lifts, the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department inspected the works of other lift contractors. So far they have checked 5 housing estates with a total of 6 buildings, plus 50 standalone buildings, and none of them had missing door frames. The department will continue to review the declaration forms submitted by contractors and conduct spot checks on the works. Since all cases of missing door frames found so far are related to 'Toi Yat', they will install door frames for the affected buildings as soon as possible.

levels.text: 機電工程署因應臺日電梯更換升降機時沒有安裝門框組件的事件，繼續巡查其他註冊升降機承辦商負責的工程，至今已巡查5個屋苑、涉及6幢樓宇，亦累計巡查了50幢單幢樓宇，當中沒有出現無安裝門框組件情況。 署方指，會檢視承辦商陸續提交的聲明書並進行抽檢。由於至今巡查顯示，沒有按要求安裝門框的個案均與「臺日」有關，現階段會集中資源盡快為該等樓宇安裝門框。
levels.text_en: In response to the incident where Toi Yat failed to install door frame components during lift replacement work, the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department has continued to inspect projects undertaken by other registered lift contractors. So far it has inspected 5 housing estates involving 6 buildings, as well as a cumulative total of 50 standalone buildings, and none of these showed a lack of door frame components. The department stated that it will review the declaration forms submitted successively by contractors and carry out spot checks. Since inspections so far show that all cases of failure to install door frames as required are related to Toi Yat, resources will at this stage be concentrated on installing door frames for those buildings as soon as possible.

articles.summary_en: A Hong Kong government department (the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department, EMSD) is investigating a problem where a lift contractor called '臺日' (Toi Yat) failed to install door frame components during lift replacement work, so the department is inspecting other lift contractors' projects to check for similar issues.

levels.text: Amica係美國一間公司，專門幫人諗定啲嘢，等佢哋唔使驚意外。佢同波士頓塞爾特人嘅球星積遜．達圖一齊拍新廣告。達圖喺球場度好識防守，他話好嘅防守係要提前諗清楚。呢樣嘢同Amica做嘅係一樣嘅。Amica都幫客人諗定晒，等有事都唔使怕。呢個廣告是由十月二十號開始，喺電視同網上播放嘅。
levels.text_en: Amica is an American company that specializes in planning things for people in advance, so they don't need to worry about accidents. They made a new ad together with Boston Celtics star Jayson Tatum. Tatum is very good at defense on the court, and he says good defense means thinking things through ahead of time. The ad started airing on October 20th, on TV and online.

levels.text: Amica保險公司推出新廣告，邀請波士頓塞爾特人球星積遜．達圖合作演出。這是雙方第三次合作，想帶出一個信息：準備非常重要。達圖是出色的防守球員，他認為好的防守需要提前想清楚下一步。保險公司也是這樣做事：預先了解客戶需要，為他們訂立計劃，幫助他們應付突發情況。Amica主席泰德．沙爾克羅斯說，公司一直提供保護客戶最重要事物的工具，積遜認同準備的重要性，所以是這次廣告的理想人選。廣告由創意公司Mother New York製作，透過畫面展示達圖準備防守，以及Amica職員幫助家庭做好準備。廣告十月二十日開始在電視、串流和數碼平台播放。Amica成立於一九零七年，總部在羅德島州林肯市，是美國歷史最悠久的互惠汽車保險公司，資產有六十三億美元，有三千五百多名員工。公司的客戶服務評價很高，曾經在JD Power的調查中得到第一名，又連續六年被《福布斯》評為美國最佳保險公司之一。
levels.text_en: Amica Insurance Company has launched a new ad, inviting Boston Celtics star Jayson Tatum to collaborate. This is the third collaboration between the two sides, aiming to convey a message: preparation is extremely important. Tatum is an outstanding defensive player, and he believes good defense requires thinking clearly about the next step in advance. The insurance company works the same way: understanding customers' needs in advance, setting up plans for them, and helping them handle sudden situations. Amica Chairman Ted Sarckrossa said the company has always provided tools to protect customers' most important things, and Jayson agrees with the importance of preparation, making him an ideal choice for this ad. The ad was produced by creative company Mother New York, showing through visuals Tatum preparing for defense, as well as Amica staff helping families prepare. The ad started airing on October 20th on TV, streaming, and digital platforms. Amica was founded in 1907, headquartered in Lincoln, Rhode Island, and is the oldest mutual auto insurance company in the US, with assets of 6.3 billion dollars and more than 3,500 employees. Amica互惠保險公司推出最新品牌宣傳活動，邀請波士頓塞爾特人籃球巨星積遜．達圖參與。這次是Amica與達圖的第三次宣傳活動，旨在展示準備是應對突發情況的關鍵，將球場上強勁的防守與Amica致力為投保人提供最佳保障的承諾聯繫起來。

達圖以其全能防守球員的身份聞名，他展示了良好的防守是主動而非被動的。這需要仔細準備並了解下一步可能發生的情況。Amica亦採取相同策略，透過預測客戶需求、制定符合這些需求的計劃，並協助他們為突發情況做好準備。

Amica與塞爾特人球星積遜．達圖的最新宣傳活動，強調球場內外準備的重要性。 AP圖片

Amica主席、總裁兼行政總裁泰德．沙爾克羅斯表示：「在Amica，我們為投保人提供保護最重要事物的工具，協助他們安心。積遜認同準備的重要性，這使他成為這次宣傳活動的理想合作夥伴。」

這次宣傳活動與創意代理公司Mother New York合作開發，透過視覺敘事將這些共通點呈現出來，展示達圖的防守準備，同時亦有Amica代表協助家庭為突發情況做好準備。結果是共同信念的創意表達：最佳防禦是預先準備和規劃的。

Amica首席增長及市場推廣總監托里．帕奇斯指出：「無論是防守球場還是保護最重要事物，最佳防禦是在需要之前很久就建立的。周全的準備是達圖在比賽中展現的核心精神，也是Amica每天為客戶提供的服務。這次宣傳活動透過展示主動準備在突發情況發生時能發揮關鍵作用，將這種聯繫呈現出來。」

這次宣傳活動於10月20日開始在全國的電視、串流及數碼平台播放。

Amica互惠保險公司成立於1907年，總部設於羅德島州林肯市，是美國歷史最悠久的互惠汽車保險公司，在全國提供汽車、家居、人壽及綜合保險保單。Amica擁有63億美元資產及超過3,500名員工，致力讓客戶安心並與全國客戶建立長久關係，保護他們最重要的一切。

Amica屢獲殊榮的客戶服務以同理心和關懷為本。該公司在JD Power新英格蘭地區的家居保險索償滿意度及汽車保險客戶滿意度方面獲評為第一名。Amica亦連續六年獲《福布斯》評為美國最佳保險公司之一，並獲AM Best評為財務穩定性A+級。
levels.text_en:
Amica Mutual Insurance Company has launched its latest brand campaign, inviting Boston Celtics basketball superstar Jayson Tatum to participate. This is the third campaign between Amica and Tatum, aiming to show that preparation is the key to handling unexpected situations, linking strong defense on the basketball court with Amica's commitment to providing policyholders with the best protection.

Tatum is known as an all-around defensive player, and he demonstrates that good defense is proactive rather than reactive. This requires careful preparation and understanding of what might happen next. Amica takes the same approach — by anticipating customers' needs, creating plans that meet those needs, and helping them prepare for unexpected situations.

Amica's latest campaign with Celtics star Jayson Tatum emphasizes the importance of preparation both on and off the court. (AP photo)

Ted Sarckrossa, Amica's Chairman, President and CEO, said: "At Amica, we provide policyholders with tools to protect what matters most to them, helping them have peace of mind. Jayson shares our belief in the importance of preparation, which makes him an ideal partner for this campaign."

This campaign was developed in collaboration with creative agency Mother New York, presenting these shared values through visual storytelling — showing Tatum's defensive preparation, as well as Amica representatives helping families prepare for unexpected situations. The result is a creative expression of a shared belief: the best defense is built through preparation and planning in advance.

Amica's Chief Growth and Marketing Officer Tori Pachis noted: "Whether defending on the court or protecting what matters most, the best defense is built long before it's needed. Thorough preparation is the core spirit Tatum shows in games, and it's also what Amica provides to customers every day. This campaign brings out that connection by showing how proactive preparation plays a crucial role when unexpected situations occur."

The campaign began airing nationwide on TV, streaming, and digital platforms starting October 20th.

Amica Mutual Insurance Company was founded in 1907, headquartered in Lincoln, Rhode Island, and is the oldest mutual auto insurance company in the US, offering auto, home, life, and umbrella insurance policies nationwide. Amica has 6.3 billion dollars in assets and more than 3,500 employees, dedicated to giving customers peace of mind and building long-term relationships with customers nationwide, protecting everything that matters most to them.

Amica's award-winning customer service is based on empathy and care. The company was ranked first in JD Power's New England region for home insurance claims satisfaction and auto insurance customer satisfaction. Amica has also been named one of America's best insurance companies by Forbes for six consecutive years, and has been rated A+ for financial stability by AM Best.

articles.title: 【人事世界】心理社會危害，如何解讀？ – Sydney HR的日與夜
articles.summary: 呢篇文講澳洲職場嘅「心理社會危害」好難界定，因為好多嘢要睇係咪長期同埋嚴重先算有問題。

levels.text: 澳洲有個詞叫「心理社會危害」。佢嘅意思好闊，好似工作太多、冇人支持、角色唔清楚，都算喺入面。但幾多先算太多？邊個先算冇支持？呢啲冇固定答案。我哋要睇係咪長期發生，先會變成真正危害。如果主管只係要求做好啲，唔等於佢做錯。但如果公司用羞辱或者唔合理嘅方法，就可能有問題。總之，一件事單獨睇冇咩，但幾件事加埋，就可能出現大問題。
levels.text_en: In Australia there's a term called 'psychosocial hazard.' Its meaning is very broad — things like too much work, no support, unclear roles can all count. But how much counts as 'too much'? Who counts as 'no support'? There's no fixed answer for these. We need to look at whether it happens long-term for it to become a real hazard. If a supervisor just asks you to do better, that doesn't mean they did something wrong. But if the company uses humiliation or unreasonable methods, that could be a problem. In short, looking at one single thing alone might seem fine, but when several things pile up together, a big problem can emerge.

levels.text: 澳洲職場近年經常提到「心理社會危害」這個詞。它的範圍很廣，包括工作量太高、自主權太低、角色不清楚、缺乏支援等等。問題是，這些界線很模糊：怎樣才算「太高」或「太低」？官方機構指出，不是單一事件就算危害，而是要長期、頻繁或嚴重地發生，才會形成真正風險。例如主管要求員工改善表現，本身屬於正常管理；但如果用羞辱或不合理的方式處理，就可能變成欺凌。同樣地，員工感到壓力，不代表公司一定做錯；但公司也不能把所有問題都推給員工。最後，很多職場問題本身看似很小，但當人手不足、工作量增加、時間緊迫等因素同時出現，就可能疊加成嚴重的工作系統問題。
levels.text_en: In recent years, Australian workplaces have often mentioned the term 'psychosocial hazard.' Its scope is very broad, including excessive workload, too little autonomy, unclear roles, lack of support, and so on. The problem is that these boundaries are vague: what counts as 'too high' or 'too low'? Official bodies point out that it's not a single incident that counts as a hazard — it has to occur long-term, frequently, or severely for it to become a real risk. For example, a supervisor asking an employee to improve their performance is itself normal management; but if it's handled through humiliation or unreasonable methods, it could become bullying. Likewise, an employee feeling stressed doesn't necessarily mean the company did something wrong; but the company also can't push all the problems onto the employee. Finally, many workplace issues may seem small on their own, but when understaffing, increased workload, time pressure, and other factors occur together, they can stack up into a serious problem with the work system.

levels.text: 近年澳洲職場愈來愈常聽到一個詞語：Psychosocial Hazards，中文一般叫「心理社會危害」。Safe Work Australia列出嘅例子包括高工作要求、低工作自主權、 缺乏支援、角色不清、組織變革管理不善、缺乏認同及獎勵、 組織公平問題、創傷性事件、遙距或孤立工作、暴力、欺凌、騷擾、 職場衝突，以及不良工作關係等。呢啲危害可以來自工作設計、 管理方式、工作環境，甚至同事之間嘅互動。 如果你聽完能夠即刻解到嘅話，你叻。因為，定義其實可以好闊， 任君解讀。 例如「高工作要求」，幾多先叫高？ 一個經理要求員工三日完成一份報告，係正常工作要求， 定係心理社會危害？「低工作自主權」又係點計？公司有工作程序、 有KPI、有主管監督，本身都係正常管理， 但如果主管連員工點做一件低風險嘅日常工作都要逐步批准， 係咪又變成另一回事？Safe Work Australia亦指出，低工作自主權唔係單純「 有人派工作畀你」就算，而係當員工長期或者經常對工作點做、 幾時做，甚至日常決定都冇合理控制權，先可能形成危害。Once again，任君解讀。 「角色不清」更加有趣。一個新人頭幾個星期唔清楚自己做咩， 好正常；但如果公司長期冇清晰匯報線、兩個人負責同一件事、 每個主管都有唔同要求、deadline不停改， 而員工又要為結果負責，情況就完全唔同。Safe Work Australia甚至直接將責任重疊、匯報線不清、 互相矛盾或者經常改變嘅工作要求、唔知道邊樣工作最重要， 列作角色不清嘅例子。 所以，心理社會危害最麻煩嘅地方，係佢涵蓋面太闊。 一個主管要求員工改善表現，可以係正常管理；但如果主管用羞辱、 威嚇、針對性或者不合理方式處理，就可能變成另一回事。Fair Work Commission亦特別強調，合理嘅performance management、紀律行動、指出工作表現問題， 本身並唔等於欺凌；真正要睇嘅係管理行動係咪合理， 以及執行方式係咪合理。 換句話講，員工覺得辛苦，唔代表公司一定做錯；員工感到壓力， 亦唔代表公司一定製造咗心理社會危害。 但反過來，企業亦唔可以將所有問題都推返落員工身上。 Safe Work Australia指出，一個心理社會危害可能唔係一次事件， 而係當員工長期、頻繁或者嚴重暴露喺某種工作因素之下， 風險先開始增加。例如缺乏支援， 唔係主管今日開會冇時間答你一條問題就算，而係長期冇足夠資源、 資訊、主管支援或者同事協助，令員工根本冇辦法做好份工。 好多職場問題，本身唔一定係一件「大事」， 但當幾個因素長期疊加，就可能變成另一回事。 人手不足令工作量增加，工作量增加令時間壓力增加， 時間壓力令員工冇時間休息，主管又冇足夠時間提供支援， 最後同事之間開始互相埋怨。單獨睇每一件事， 好似都唔係咩大問題；但放埋一齊， 就可能形成一個工作系
levels.text_en: In recent years, Australian workplaces have increasingly heard a term: Psychosocial Hazards, generally translated as 'psychosocial hazard' in Chinese. Examples listed by Safe Work Australia include high job demands, low job control, lack of support, lack of role clarity, poor organisational change management, lack of recognition and reward, organisational justice issues, traumatic events, remote or isolated work, violence, bullying, harassment, workplace conflict, and poor workplace relationships. These hazards can come from job design, management practices, the work environment, and even interactions between colleagues. If you can fully understand this right after hearing it, you're impressive — because the definitions can actually be very broad, open to interpretation by anyone. For example, take 'high job demands' — how much counts as 'high'? If a manager asks an employee to finish a report in three days, is that a normal work demand or a psychosocial hazard? How is 'low job control' calculated? A company having work procedures, KPIs, and supervisor oversight is itself normal management — but if a supervisor requires approval for every single step of even a low-risk routine daily task, does that become something else? Safe Work Australia also points out that low job control isn't simply a matter of 'someone assigning you work' — it's when an employee has, long-term or frequently, no reasonable control over how or when work is done, or even over everyday decisions, that a hazard may form. Once again, open to interpretation. 'Unclear roles' is even more interesting. It's normal for a new employee to be unclear about their duties for the first few weeks; but if a company has no clear reporting lines long-term, two people are responsible for the same task, every supervisor has different requirements, deadlines keep changing, and the employee still has to be accountable for the results — that's a completely different situation. Safe Work Australia even directly lists overlapping responsibilities, unclear reporting lines, contradictory or frequently changing work requirements, and not knowing which task is most important as examples of unclear roles. So the most troublesome thing about psychosocial hazards is that their scope is too broad. A supervisor asking an employee to improve performance can be normal management; but if the supervisor handles it through humiliation, intimidation, targeting, or unreasonable methods, it could become something else. The Fair Work Commission also specifically emphasizes that reasonable performance management, disciplinary action, and pointing out performance issues do not in themselves constitute bullying; what really matters is whether the management action is reasonable and whether it is carried out in a reasonable way. In other words, an employee finding things hard doesn't necessarily mean the company did something wrong; an employee feeling stressed doesn't necessarily mean the company created a psychosocial hazard. But conversely, companies also cannot push all problems back onto employees. Safe Work Australia points out that a psychosocial hazard may not be a single incident, but rather that risk begins to increase when an employee is exposed to a certain work factor long-term, frequently, or severely. For example, lack of support isn't just about a supervisor not having time today in a meeting to answer a question — it's about long-term insufficient resources, information, supervisor support, or colleague assistance, which leaves the employee with no way to do their job well. Many workplace problems aren't necessarily a single 'big issue' on their own, but when several factors stack up over a long period, they can turn into something else. Understaffing increases workload, increased workload increases time pressure, time pressure leaves employees no time to rest, supervisors don't have enough time to provide support, and eventually colleagues start resenting each other. Looking at each thing alone, none seems like a big problem; but put together, they may form a problem with the entire work system.

articles.summary_en: This is a blog post from an Australian HR-focused site explaining the concept of 'psychosocial hazards' in the workplace, a term used by Australian work-safety bodies (like Safe Work Australia and the Fair Work Commission) to describe risks like high workload, low autonomy, unclear roles, and lack of support.

articles.title: 百年前淘金華工攜譚公像赴加國　路邊木龕變譚公廟　獲列歷史遺址
articles.summary: 百幾年前，有個廣東客家人帶住譚公神像去加拿大淘金，之後起廟，而家間廟成為咗加拿大嘅國家歷史遺址。

levels.text: 好耐之前，廣東有個客家人叫魏泗，佢帶住譚公神像去咗加拿大淘金。那時很多華工在外地做工很辛苦，還要交很多稅。佢哋喺維多利亞起咗間細廟拜譚公，求平安。後來越來越多人前來參拜，廟宇建得更大了。而家呢間廟已經有成一百年歷史。加拿大政府認為這裏很重要，要保護它。
levels.text_en: A long time ago, there was a Hakka man from Guangdong named Wei Si, who brought a statue of the god Tam Kung with him to Canada to pan for gold. At that time many Chinese laborers working abroad had a very hard life and also had to pay many taxes. They built a small temple in Victoria to worship Tam Kung and pray for peace. Later, more and more people came to worship there, so the temple was built bigger. Now this temple has nearly a hundred years of history. The Canadian government considers it very important and wants to protect it.

levels.text: 十九世紀中期，廣東沿海戰亂頻繁，加上貧困，剛好加拿大菲沙河谷興起淘金熱，許多華工渡海謀生。客家人魏泗帶着家鄉的譚公神像一同前往，抵達維多利亞後，在路邊木龕供奉譚公，讓同鄉參拜求平安。後來鄉親集資建廟，1876年舉行開光儀式，譚公廟正式成立。十九世紀八十年代，大批華工參與興建加拿大太平洋鐵路，傷亡慘重，其後政府又徵收人頭稅，甚至在1923年通過排華法案，幾乎禁止華人入境。維多利亞華埠成為華人的避風港，人和會館在1912年建成大樓，把譚公廟遷到三樓，既可防範衝突，也方便聚會。1980年廟宇曾遭大火，幸好神像和文物都保存下來。2025年，加拿大政府正式將譚公廟列為國家歷史遺址，肯定了華人在加拿大歷史上的貢獻。
levels.text_en: In the mid-19th century, the coastal areas of Guangdong suffered frequent wars and poverty, and at that time a gold rush broke out in the Fraser Valley of Canada, so many Chinese laborers crossed the ocean to make a living. The Hakka man Wei Si brought the Tam Kung statue from his hometown with him. After arriving in Victoria, he enshrined Tam Kung in a roadside wooden shrine, allowing fellow villagers to worship and pray for peace. Later, fellow villagers raised funds together to build a temple, and in 1876 a consecration ceremony was held, officially establishing the Tam Kung Temple. In the 1880s, large numbers of Chinese laborers took part in building the Canadian Pacific Railway, suffering heavy casualties. Afterward the government imposed a head tax, and in 1923 even passed the Chinese Exclusion Act, almost completely banning Chinese immigration. Victoria's Chinatown became a refuge for Chinese people. The Yen Wo Society built its building in 1912 and moved the Tam Kung Temple to the third floor, both to avoid conflict and to make gatherings convenient. In 1980 the temple suffered a fire, but fortunately the statue and artifacts were preserved. In 2025, the Canadian government officially designated the Tam Kung Temple as a National Historic Site, affirming the contribution of Chinese people to Canadian history.

levels.text: 1860淘金熱：客家礦工為何帶神像到異鄉？ 19世紀中葉，廣東沿海戰亂與貧困交加，恰逢加拿大菲沙河谷（Fraser Valley）爆發淘金熱，數以千計華工告別家鄉，擠在狹窄木船艙內，橫渡風浪莫測的太平洋，懷着黃金美夢，期盼可早日抵達異鄉。在條件極度惡劣的淘金營地，疾病、礦坑塌方與白人礦工的暴力排擠隨處可見。對於習慣海上與水邊謀生的客家、廣府移民而言，掌管天氣與健康、護佑平安的譚公，是遠渡重洋求生路上最珍貴的精神寄託。 開啟這段跨洋信仰史的先行者，是來自廣東五華的客家人魏泗。19世紀60年代，年輕的魏泗跟隨淘金熱浪潮輾轉赴美，最終來到卑詩維多利亞，他將家鄉供奉的譚公神像隨身攜帶、跨海遠渡。抵達當地後，他將神像安奉在Johnson Street峽谷的路邊木龕，供所有進山淘金的同鄉叩拜祈福。這座不起眼的小小神龕，就此成為荒涼異域中首個凝聚華人精神、安放鄉愁與希望的實體地標。 其後社群持續發展，1875年魏泗牽頭、聯合客籍鄉親集資租屋建廟，翌年舉行開光儀式，讓原本的路邊簡易神龕，正式升級為制度化的譚公廟，此後廟宇又數度搬遷、代代傳承。 從太平洋鐵路到人頭稅：華工如何建「樓上廟」？ 淘金熱退潮，華工的命運並未好轉。1880年代，數萬華工參與加拿大太平洋鐵路（Canadian Pacific Railway）最艱險路段鋪設，不少人喪生於懸崖與爆破事故。然而鐵路竣工之日，迎來的卻是加拿大政府1885年實施的「人頭稅」（Head Tax），稅額由1885年的50加元逐步飆升至1903年的500加元，大約相當於當時華工2年工資。1923年，當局更通過惡名昭彰的《華人移民法》，也就是俗稱的《排華法案》，幾乎全面禁止華人入境。 在社會全面排斥華人的風氣下，維多利亞華埠（Victoria Chinatown）成為華工僅有的避風港。客籍華人組成的人和會館（Yen Wo Society）於1905年成立，1911年購地，1912年建成現存的會館大樓，同時將代代傳承的譚公廟遷入建築3樓頂層。 為何要將神聖空間設於頂層？ 根據 加拿大公園局（Parks Canada） 歷史檔案記載，這個空間安排，一方面源自華人傳統觀念，神聖空間希望「更接近天」；現實層面，把廟宇設在樓上，可遠離街頭嘈雜與潛在種族衝突，兼具安全防禦與社區聚會功能。頂樓香火繚繞，樓下處理族群事務、接濟貧困同鄉，這座「樓上廟」，成為華人在北美嚴酷生存環境下搭建的族群庇護所。 一尊神像歷經百年獲列國家歷史遺址 一多世紀過去，廟內古老鐵鐘仍靜靜懸掛，牆上捐題芳名錄記載幾代華工的姓名與汗水。廟宇曾於1980年遭遇大火，幸搶救及時，古老神像與文物被完整保存。2025年，加拿大聯邦政府確認指定維多利亞譚公廟為國家歷史遺址，確立譚公廟在加拿大華人移民史的重要地位，華裔社群的歷史經驗被正式納入國家歷史敘事。
levels.text_en: 1860s Gold Rush: Why did Hakka miners bring a deity statue to a foreign land? In the mid-19th century, the coastal areas of Guangdong were beset by war and poverty, just as a gold rush broke out in Canada's Fraser Valley. Thousands of Chinese laborers left their hometowns, crowding into narrow wooden ship cabins to cross the unpredictable Pacific Ocean, dreaming of gold and hoping to reach the foreign land soon. In the extremely harsh conditions of the gold mining camps, disease, mine collapses, and violent exclusion by white miners were common. For Hakka and Cantonese immigrants accustomed to making a living by the sea and waterways, Tam Kung—who presides over weather and health and protects peace—was the most precious spiritual support on their perilous journey across the ocean. The pioneer who began this transoceanic history of faith was Wei Si, a Hakka man from Wuhua, Guangdong. In the 1860s, the young Wei Si followed the gold rush wave to the United States and eventually arrived in Victoria, British Columbia. He carried the Tam Kung statue worshipped in his hometown with him across the ocean. After arriving, he placed the statue in a roadside wooden shrine in the Johnson Street ravine, for all fellow villagers heading into the mountains to pan for gold to bow to and pray for blessings. This unremarkable little shrine thus became the first physical landmark in this desolate foreign land to unite the Chinese community's spirit and hold their homesickness and hope. Afterward, the community continued to develop. In 1875, Wei Si led fellow Hakka villagers in raising funds to rent a building and construct a temple, and the following year a consecration ceremony was held, upgrading the original simple roadside shrine into a formal Tam Kung Temple. Since then the temple has relocated several times and been passed down through generations. From the Pacific Railway to the Head Tax: How did Chinese laborers build the 'upstairs temple'? After the gold rush subsided, the fate of Chinese laborers did not improve. In the 1880s, tens of thousands of Chinese laborers took part in laying the most dangerous sections of the Canadian Pacific Railway, with many dying in cliffside and explosive accidents. Yet when the railway was completed, what awaited them was the Head Tax imposed by the Canadian government in 1885, which rose from 50 Canadian dollars in 1885 to 500 dollars in 1903—roughly equivalent to two years' wages for a Chinese laborer at the time. In 1923, the authorities passed the notorious Chinese Immigration Act, commonly known as the Chinese Exclusion Act, which almost completely banned Chinese people from entering the country. Amid widespread social exclusion of Chinese people, Victoria's Chinatown became the only refuge for Chinese laborers. The Yen Wo Society, formed by Hakka Chinese, was established in 1905, purchased land in 1911, and completed the current society building in 1912, at the same time moving the Tam Kung Temple, passed down through generations, to the top third floor of the building. Why place the sacred space on the top floor? According to historical records from Parks Canada, this arrangement stemmed partly from traditional Chinese beliefs that a sacred space should be 'closer to heaven'; practically, placing the temple upstairs kept it away from street noise and potential racial conflict, serving both as a safety measure and a place for community gatherings. With incense burning on the top floor and community affairs and aid for poor fellow villagers handled downstairs, this 'upstairs temple' became a refuge built by Chinese people under the harsh conditions of survival in North America. A statue that endured a century to be listed as a National Historic Site. More than a century later, the temple's old iron bell still hangs quietly, and the donor plaques on the walls record the names and sweat of generations of Chinese laborers. The temple suffered a fire in 1980, but fortunately it was put out in time, and the ancient statue and artifacts were fully preserved. In 2025, the Canadian federal government officially designated the Victoria Tam Kung Temple as a National Historic Site, establishing the temple's important position in the history of Chinese immigration to Canada, and formally incorporating the historical experience of the Chinese community into the national historical narrative.

articles.summary_en: This article tells the history of the Tam Kung Temple in Victoria, Canada, founded by Chinese gold-rush laborers in the 19th century, and its recent recognition as a Canadian national historic site.

articles.title: 打風？天文台預測颱風薔琵逐漸增強+奇特路徑　專家警告：範圍大
articles.summary: 颱風薔琵依家喺關島附近，之後可能轉彎去日本，但天文台話十月都唔會直接吹襲香港。

levels.text: 颱風薔琵喺關島附近，佢會慢慢變強，然後向台灣方向去。到下星期初，它會轉彎，向東北方向吹向日本，並經過東京附近。天文台話而家9月冇熱帶氣旋入南海好少見。他們預計10月的機會不大，熱帶氣旋直接影響香港。不過天氣變化好大，大家要留意最新消息。
levels.text_en: Typhoon Podul is near Guam and will gradually strengthen, then move toward Taiwan. By early next week, it will turn and blow northeast toward Japan, passing near Tokyo. The Observatory says it's rare for no tropical cyclone to enter the South China Sea in September. They predict a low chance of a tropical cyclone directly affecting Hong Kong in October. However, weather changes a lot, so everyone should watch for the latest updates.

levels.text: 颱風薔琵目前接近關島，預計會逐漸增強，並向台灣方向移動。下週初，它可能轉向東北，吹向日本，並經過東京附近。天文台指出，今年9月沒有熱帶氣旋進入南海，情況罕見。由於南海一帶大氣環流不利，天文台預料10月底前熱帶氣旋直接影響香港的機會不大。不過天氣預測仍有變數，情況可能隨時改變。
levels.text_en: Typhoon Podul is currently near Guam and is expected to gradually strengthen while moving toward Taiwan. Early next week, it may turn northeast, blowing toward Japan and passing near Tokyo. The Observatory points out that this September, no tropical cyclone entered the South China Sea, which is a rare occurrence. Because atmospheric circulation over the South China Sea region is unfavorable, the Observatory expects the chance of a tropical cyclone directly affecting Hong Kong before the end of October to be low. However, weather forecasts still have uncertainties, and the situation could change at any time.

levels.text: ECMWF預測颱風薔琵路徑大轉彎掠過日本 歐洲中期天氣預報中心（ECMWF）預測，關島東南面有熱帶氣旋形成，並逐漸增強，往西北方向移動，逼近台灣，但10月22日至10月23日會90度大轉彎，往東北方向移動吹襲日本，10月23日至10月24日在日本東京附近掠過，隨後遠離。 即看ECMWF最新颱風薔琵路徑預測▼▼▼ 風烏、伏羲、盤古天氣模式預測「3旋共舞」橫掃日本 至於天氣模式風烏、伏羲、盤古，同樣預測關島東南面會有熱帶氣旋形成，逐漸增強往西北方向移動，10月21日至10月22日最接近台灣，比ECMWF預測的更近，隨後會90度大轉彎移向日本，10月23日至10月25日「橫掃」日本，但「橫掃」位置略有不同。風烏天氣模式更預測，連同這個熱帶氣旋，西北太平洋同一時間會有3個熱帶氣旋，形成「3旋共舞」現象。 即看風烏最新颱風路徑預測▼▼▼ 即看盤古最新颱風路徑預測▼▼▼ 即看伏羲最新颱風路徑預測▼▼▼ 天文台：9月無熱帶氣旋進入南海情況不常見 預測10月有熱帶氣旋直接影響本港機會不大 天文台預測，熱帶氣旋薔琵會在未來一兩日逐漸增強並橫過關島一帶，於下週初至中期移向呂宋以東海域，但其隨後路徑存在變數，有較大機會轉向偏北方向橫過台灣以東海域。 不過天文台早前以「2026年風季已完結？」發表《天氣隨筆》，指剛過去的9月，由於熱帶氣旋形成位置較正常偏東，加上副熱帶高壓脊的引導氣流有利西北太平洋上形成的風暴轉向偏北移向日本一帶，以致該月並沒有於西北太平洋形成的熱帶氣旋進入南海，翻查歷史資料，此情況並不常見。 天文台又說，比對8月和9月的海面溫度距平分析，可見南海的海面溫度有下降迹象，其中南海北部和中部的降溫較為顯著。同時，南海至菲律賓一帶的大氣低層自9月下旬起已建立反氣旋環流異常，大大抑制該區的深厚對流發展，而最新的氣候模式普遍預測該反氣旋環流異常將持續影響南海至10月下旬，大氣環流和海洋條件均不利於熱帶氣旋生成，意味即使有低壓區於南海形成，其進一步發展為熱帶氣旋的空間亦相當有限，因此，預料本月（10月）餘下時間有熱帶氣旋直接影響本港的機會不大。 不過目前為時尚早，天氣預測受多項因素影響，變化很大，不同預測模式都只能當作參考。 天文台九天天氣預測 本港天氣方面，天文台預測，受一股清勁的偏東氣流影響，未來一兩日廣東沿岸風勢較大，有一兩陣雨。隨著高空反氣旋增強，下週初至中期華南沿岸大致天晴及乾燥，日間炎熱。預料一股東北季候風會在下週後期影響華南。 根據天文台九天天氣預報，未來九天氣溫26°C至32°C，暫時最高吹5級風。
levels.text_en: ECMWF forecasts a sharp turn in Typhoon Podul's path, grazing Japan: The European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) predicts that a tropical cyclone forming southeast of Guam will gradually strengthen and move northwest, approaching Taiwan, but between October 22–23 it will make a 90-degree turn, moving northeast toward Japan, passing near Tokyo between October 23–24, before moving away. See the latest ECMWF typhoon Podul path forecast below. Weather models Fengwu, Fuxi, and Pangu predict a '3 cyclones dance' sweeping Japan: As for the Fengwu, Fuxi, and Pangu weather models, they similarly predict a tropical cyclone forming southeast of Guam, gradually strengthening and moving northwest, coming closest to Taiwan between October 21–22 (closer than ECMWF's prediction), then making a 90-degree turn toward Japan, 'sweeping across' Japan between October 23–25, though the exact sweep locations differ slightly between models. The Fengwu model further predicts that, along with this tropical cyclone, there will be three tropical cyclones simultaneously in the Northwest Pacific, forming a '3 cyclones dance' phenomenon. See the latest Fengwu, Pangu, and Fuxi typhoon path forecasts below. Observatory: It's unusual for no tropical cyclone to enter the South China Sea in September; forecast shows low chance of direct impact on Hong Kong in October: The Observatory forecasts that tropical cyclone Podul will gradually strengthen over the next one to two days and pass through the Guam area, moving toward waters east of Luzon by early to mid next week, but its subsequent path remains uncertain, with a relatively higher chance of turning northward and passing through waters east of Taiwan. However, the Observatory had earlier published a 'Weather Blog' titled 'Has the 2026 typhoon season ended?', noting that in the past September, because tropical cyclones formed further east than normal, combined with the subtropical high's steering flow favoring storms forming in the Northwest Pacific to turn north toward Japan, no tropical cyclone that formed in the Northwest Pacific entered the South China Sea that month — checking historical records, this is uncommon. The Observatory also said that comparing sea surface temperature anomalies between August and September, there are signs of cooling sea surface temperatures in the South China Sea, with more significant cooling in the northern and central parts. Meanwhile, since late September, an anomalous anticyclonic circulation has been established in the lower atmosphere over the South China Sea to the Philippines area, greatly suppressing deep convection development in that region. The latest climate models generally predict that this anomalous anticyclonic circulation will continue to affect the South China Sea until late October, with both atmospheric circulation and ocean conditions unfavorable for tropical cyclone formation. This means that even if a low-pressure area forms in the South China Sea, there is quite limited room for it to further develop into a tropical cyclone. Therefore, it is expected that for the remainder of this month (October), the chance of a tropical cyclone directly affecting Hong Kong is low. However, it is still too early to tell, as weather forecasts are affected by many factors and can change greatly; different forecast models should only be taken as reference. Observatory's nine-day weather forecast: Regarding Hong Kong's weather, the Observatory forecasts that, affected by a fresh easterly airflow, the Guangdong coast will experience stronger winds and occasional showers over the next day or two. As the upper-level anticyclone strengthens, the South China coast will generally be sunny and dry from early to mid next week, with hot daytime temperatures. A northeast monsoon is expected to affect South China in the latter part of next week. According to the Observatory's nine-day forecast, temperatures over the next nine days will range from 26°C to 32°C, with winds currently reaching up to force 5.

articles.summary: 選舉委員會嘅選舉今日收到29份提名表格，有啲人想入去做委員。

levels.text: 選舉委員會嘅選舉，今日收到29份提名表格。當中26份是候選人表格，建築測量都市規劃同園境界最多，有12份。社會福利界有8份。另外3份係團體表格，一份屬宗教界，兩份屬內地港人團體。提名由上星期三開始，到本月20日結束。而家總共收到1112份候選人表格，和38份團體表格。
levels.text_en: The Election Committee's election received 29 nomination forms today. Of these, 26 are candidate forms, with the Architectural, Surveying, Town Planning and Landscape subsector having the most, 12 forms. The Social Welfare subsector has 8. Another 3 are group forms, one belonging to the Religious subsector, and two belonging to Mainland Hong Kong Residents' associations. Nominations started last Wednesday and end on the 20th of this month. So far a total of 1112 candidate forms and 38 group forms have been received.

levels.text: 選舉事務處表示，選舉委員會的選舉今日收到29份提名表格。當中26份是候選人提名表格，建築、測量、都市規劃及園境界最多，有12份；社會福利界有8份。另外3份是團體提名表格，分別屬於宗教界和內地港人團體。提名期由上星期三開始，到本月20日結束。目前累計收到1112份候選人提名表格，以及38份團體提名表格。
levels.text_en: The Registration and Electoral Office said the Election Committee's election received 29 nomination forms today. Of these, 26 are candidate nomination forms, with the Architectural, Surveying, Town Planning and Landscape subsector having the most, 12 forms; the Social Welfare subsector has 8. Another 3 are group nomination forms, belonging respectively to the Religious subsector and Mainland Hong Kong Residents' associations. The nomination period began last Wednesday and ends on the 20th of this month. So far a cumulative total of 1112 candidate nomination forms and 38 group nomination forms have been received.

levels.text: 選舉事務處表示，選委會界別分組一般選舉，今日共接獲29份提名表格。 其中26份候選人提名表格，以建築、測量、都市規劃及園境界佔最多，有12份、其次為社會福利界，有8份；另外3份指定團體提名表格，分別為宗教界和內地港人團體代表。 提名期自上周三開始，至本月20日結束，至今累計共接獲1112份候選人提名表格，及38份指定團體提名表格。
levels.text_en: The Registration and Electoral Office said that for the Election Committee subsector ordinary election, 29 nomination forms were received today in total. Of these, 26 are candidate nomination forms, with the Architectural, Surveying, Town Planning and Landscape subsector accounting for the most, with 12; followed by the Social Welfare subsector, with 8. Another 3 are designated body nomination forms, representing respectively the Religious subsector and Mainland Hong Kong Residents' associations. The nomination period began last Wednesday and ends on the 20th of this month. To date, a cumulative total of 1112 candidate nomination forms and 38 designated body nomination forms have been received.

levels.text_en: The Election Committee is currently choosing people. The group 'Representatives of members of New Territories District Committees, District Fight Crime Committees, and District Fire Safety Committees' received the most candidate forms, with 18. The 'Wholesale and Retail' subsector came second, with 10. The nomination period started last Wednesday and will end on the 20th of this month. The Registration and Electoral Office has so far received a total of 1061 candidate forms and 32 group forms.

articles.title: 【馮睎乾十三維度】英國救生艇不應遺下最需要逃生的人
articles.summary: 吳偉豪喺香港坐完監之後仲被人跟蹤監視，去到英國想攞簽證留低都好難。

levels.text: 有個香港人叫吳偉豪，2019年因為帶汽油彈畀警察拉咗，坐咗五年監。出獄後，佢喺香港成日畀人跟蹤監視，過得好辛苦。佢去英國想攞簽證留低，但因為以前有案底，申請一直被拒絕。佢話喺監入面曾經俾人性侵，情緒好低落，仲試過自殺。而家佢仲喺英國等機會，希望可以留低。
levels.text_en: There's a Hong Konger named Ng Wai-ho. In 2019 he was arrested by police for carrying petrol bombs and spent five years in prison. After getting out, he was constantly followed and watched in Hong Kong, and life was very hard. He went to the UK hoping to get a visa to stay, but because of his past criminal record, his application kept being rejected. He says that in prison he was once sexually assaulted, became very depressed, and even attempted suicide. He is still in the UK now, waiting for a chance, hoping he can stay.

levels.text: 2019年，吳偉豪因為持有汽油彈被捕，判監五年。出獄後，他在香港不斷遭受跟蹤和監視，生活困難。他其後前往英國，希望申請居留，但由於過去的刑事紀錄，申請一直被拒絕。他透露在獄中曾經遭受性侵，情緒低落，甚至企圖自殺。現時他仍在英國等待審批結果，盼望能夠留下生活。
levels.text_en: In 2019, Ng Wai-ho was arrested for possessing petrol bombs and sentenced to five years in prison. After his release, he was continually followed and monitored in Hong Kong, making life difficult. He later went to the UK hoping to apply for residency, but because of his past criminal record, his applications kept being rejected. He revealed that he had been sexually assaulted in prison, became emotionally depressed, and even attempted suicide. He is currently still in the UK awaiting the outcome of his application, hoping to be able to stay and live there.

levels.text: 在正常社會，服刑完畢者理應可以重新生活，但在今日香港，「正常」並不是理所當然的。許多因2019年社會運動入獄的人，「放學」後只是換了另一個更大的監獄，飽受監視、跟蹤、滋擾和威嚇之苦；好不容易離開香港，到了英國，政治案件留下的刑事紀錄又成為移民障礙。監獄的門打開了，人生出口卻依然被堵死。 這正是英國對香港人實施的救生艇政策必須正視的問題。BN(O) 簽證計劃推出以來，已有超過20萬宗申請獲批，讓大批港人得以在英國過新生活。但對於曾因反修例運動入獄的人來說，這條逃生路卻未必暢通。英國移民規則設有刑事定罪及刑期門檻，部分申請人即使面對政治迫害風險，也可能因過往定罪而遭拒簽。 要留在英國還有另一條路——申請難民庇護，但代價可能是「被困」英國40年。英國政府去年公佈「移民白皮書」，難民政策大幅加辣，建議難民申請獲批後可以申請永居的逗留年期由5年暴增至20年；若先以旅客身分入境再申請庇護者，或再額外「加監」20年。 吳偉豪（Gilbert Ng Wai-ho）的個案，正好說明上述問題何以不能光靠一條死板的規則解決。現居英國的吳偉豪，2019年11月2日遭港警截查，在背囊內搜出四枚汽油彈及兩個氣罐，其後又在與他工作有關的貨倉發現約100公升汽油等物品。他其後承認「在公眾地方管有攻擊性武器」及「意圖摧毀或損壞財產而管有物品」等控罪，2021年被判監五年。 正因為這個背景，吳偉豪的移英之路可謂寸步難行。我們不必迴避事實，更不認為英國應該放寬審查。汽油彈涉及公共安全，任何政府都有責任認真審視這類行為。但一個刑事判決，是否足以決定一個人往後的人生呢？曾經犯法，是否就代表他永遠不可能成為政治迫害的受害者？ 真正的迫害，往往在出獄後才開始。《追光者》在7月15日刊出吳偉豪專訪，題為「社運釋囚在港遭系統性迫害 赴英尋庇護被拒 人權組織：內政部官僚作風非常虛偽」，吳表示2023年出獄後長期受到跟蹤、監視及滋擾，每逢敏感日子（如六四）更加倍被招呼，甚至連聘用他的僱主也受到壓力，令他難以繼續工作。另一方面，懲教人員持續向他施壓，要求他找工作，否則便可能再次入獄。 在情緒最低落時，吳偉豪曾一次吞服二百粒藥物企圖自殺。獲救送院後，有懲教署人員到醫院找他，說他無法適應這個社會，「有可能要我再返入赤柱」，令他幾乎崩潰。吳的獄中遭遇，連回憶也覺得痛。據吳憶述，他多次遭特權囚犯「B仔」性侵，報警後又遭懲教職員施壓撤控，還被罰單獨囚禁。最後他因求助無門、身心俱疲而撤控。最令他憤怒的是，當局為求掩飾真相，要求他在撤控陳述書中聲稱自己是同性戀，因愛慕對方才發生性行為。 在香港無法重建生活，唯有遠走英國，想不到那隻理應為他而設的「救生艇」，卻因為種種荒謬理由而拒絕他。2025年6月，吳偉豪持BN(O) 護照抵英，申請庇護。他已向內政部提交相關證據，但申請仍遭拒絕，理由包括「沒足夠證據證明在港遭受政治迫害」，又指
levels.text_en: In a normal society, someone who has finished serving their sentence should be able to start life anew — but in today's Hong Kong, 'normal' can no longer be taken for granted. Many people imprisoned over the 2019 social movement find that after 'graduating' from prison, they simply move into another, larger prison, suffering surveillance, tailing, harassment and intimidation. Having finally managed to leave Hong Kong and reach the UK, the criminal record left by their political case then becomes an obstacle to immigration. The prison door has opened, but the exit from their life remains blocked. This is precisely the problem that the UK's 'lifeboat' policy for Hong Kongers must confront. Since the BN(O) visa scheme launched, more than 200,000 applications have been approved, allowing large numbers of Hong Kongers to start new lives in the UK. But for those imprisoned over the anti-extradition-bill movement, this escape route may not be so smooth. UK immigration rules set thresholds based on criminal convictions and sentence length; some applicants, even if facing risk of political persecution, may be refused a visa because of past convictions. There is another route to staying in the UK — applying for refugee asylum — but the cost may be being 'trapped' in the UK for 40 years. Last year the UK government published an immigration white paper that significantly tightened refugee policy, proposing that the waiting period before an approved refugee can apply for permanent residency be increased drastically from 5 years to 20 years; for those who enter as tourists and then apply for asylum, an extra 20 years may be added on top. The case of Gilbert Ng Wai-ho illustrates exactly why this kind of problem cannot be solved by a rigid, one-size-fits-all rule. Now living in the UK, Ng Wai-ho was stopped and searched by Hong Kong police on 2 November 2019; four petrol bombs and two gas canisters were found in his backpack, and about 100 litres of petrol and other items were later found in a warehouse connected to his work. He subsequently admitted to charges including 'possession of an offensive weapon in a public place' and 'possession of items with intent to destroy or damage property,' and in 2021 was sentenced to five years in prison. Because of this background, Ng Wai-ho's path to moving to the UK has been extremely difficult. We need not avoid the facts, nor do we think the UK should loosen its vetting. Petrol bombs involve public safety, and any government has a responsibility to take such conduct seriously. But is a criminal conviction enough to determine the rest of a person's life? Does having once broken the law mean he can never be a victim of political persecution? Real persecution often only begins after release from prison. On 15 July, 追光者 (Photon Media) published an interview with Ng Wai-ho titled 'Social Movement Ex-Prisoner Systematically Persecuted in Hong Kong, Asylum Bid in UK Rejected; Human Rights Group: Home Office Bureaucracy Extremely Hypocritical.' Ng said that after his release in 2023 he was subjected to prolonged tailing, surveillance and harassment, which intensified on sensitive dates (such as June 4th); even the employer who hired him came under pressure, making it hard for him to keep working. Meanwhile, Correctional Services staff kept pressuring him to find a job, otherwise he might be sent back to prison. At his emotional lowest point, Ng once swallowed two hundred pills in a suicide attempt. After being rescued and sent to hospital, a Correctional Services officer came to find him there and told him he couldn't adapt to society, saying 'you may have to go back into Stanley [Prison],' which nearly broke him. Even recalling his experiences in prison is painful for Ng. According to his account, he was repeatedly sexually assaulted by a privileged inmate known as 'B仔.' When he reported it to police, correctional staff pressured him into withdrawing the complaint, and he was punished with solitary confinement. In the end, exhausted physically and mentally and with nowhere to turn for help, he withdrew the complaint. What angers him most is that, to cover up the truth, the authorities required him to state in his withdrawal statement that he was gay and that the sexual act occurred because he was attracted to the other person. Unable to rebuild his life in Hong Kong, he had no choice but to flee to the UK — only to find that the 'lifeboat' that was supposed to be there for him rejected him for all sorts of absurd reasons. In June 2025, Ng Wai-ho arrived in the UK on a BN(O) passport and applied for asylum. He submitted relevant evidence to the Home Office, but his application was still rejected, on grounds including 'insufficient evidence to prove political persecution in Hong Kong,' and also stating that...

articles.title: 【人事世界】經常缺勤是心理社會風險嘅前哨 – Sydney HR的日與夜
articles.summary: 呢篇文章話員工請病假嘅情況，其實可以反映工作入面有冇心理健康風險，所以公司應該留意返工唔返工嘅規律，唔好淨係睇一個數字。

levels.text: 「不返工」原來可能同心理健康有關。有機構話，睇返工同請假嘅紀錄，可以幫手知道工作入面係咪有問題。淨係睇一個數字唔夠，要睇返工嘅次數同模式。如果好多人在同一個部門請假，就要留意。經理不應該直接問員工是不是有心理病，應該先同他傾吓工作情況。
levels.text_en: It turns out that 'not coming to work' may actually be related to mental health. An organization says that looking at attendance and leave records can help identify whether there are problems at work. Looking at just one number isn't enough — you need to look at the frequency and pattern of attendance. If many people in the same department are taking leave, that should be noted. Managers should not directly ask employees if they have a mental illness; instead, they should first talk with them about their work situation.

levels.text: 缺勤紀錄其實可以反映工作場所的心理健康風險。Sedgwick Health Solutions最近發表報告，指出員工請假的模式，有時能反映公司內部已經存在的問題。報告指出，單一個缺勤數字本身意義不大。但如果某部門的短期病假突然增加，加班時間同時上升，員工流失率提高，而員工調查顯示工作量和上司支援評分下降，就要注意了。WorkSafe Victoria建議企業將缺勤率、流失率、離職面談、員工投入度等資料一同分析，而不是只看單一數字。澳洲現時的工作健康安全框架，已經將心理健康風險視為管理責任，包括工作量過重、職責不清、缺乏支援、職場衝突等因素。當公司發現異常缺勤模式，不應直接問員工是否有心理健康問題，而應先了解工作情況，與員工進行正常的對話。
levels.text_en: Absence records can actually reflect psychological health risks in the workplace. Sedgwick Health Solutions recently published a report pointing out that patterns of employee leave can sometimes reflect problems that already exist within a company. The report states that a single absence number by itself doesn't mean much. But if short-term sick leave in a certain department suddenly increases, along with rising overtime hours and employee turnover, while employee surveys show declining scores for workload and manager support, then it's worth paying attention to. WorkSafe Victoria recommends that companies analyze absence rates, turnover rates, exit interviews, and employee engagement data together, rather than looking at a single number alone. Australia's current work health and safety framework now treats psychological health risk as a management responsibility, including factors like excessive workload, unclear job duties, lack of support, and workplace conflict. When a company notices an abnormal absence pattern, it should not directly ask employees whether they have a mental health problem, but should first understand the work situation and have a normal conversation with the employee.

levels.text: 原來唔返工都可能係心理健康問題嘅信號？Sedgwick Health Solutions 最近發布《2026 Mental Health Absence in Australia: Trends, Costs and Compliance Guide》，就提出一個幾值得思考嘅方向： 缺勤紀錄可以成為識別 psychosocial hazards 嘅早期預警訊號。換句話講，病假本身未必係問題，但病假嘅模式， 有可能反映工作場所入面已經出現問題。 當然。Absence data 本身唔可以證明一個員工有心理健康問題， 更加唔可以單憑缺勤紀錄就斷定係某個 workplace hazard 導致員工患病。缺勤紀錄卻可以當成一個訊號， 再配合其他資料去確認風險。WorkSafe Victoria 建議企業將 缺勤率、員工流失率、離職面談、員工投入度、事故報告， 以及工傷賠償申索等資料放埋一齊睇，而唔係只睇一個數字。 例如，一間公司整體缺勤率由3.2%升到3.5%， 單睇呢個數字可能冇乜特別。但如果再拆開睇， 發現某一個department嘅短期缺勤由每人每年兩次增加到 四次，同時 OT 增加、員工流失率上升，而員工調查亦顯示 workload 同經理支援評分下降，呢個時候就已經唔可以單純當成幾個員工「 比較多病假」。 缺勤紀錄最有價值嘅地方，其實係睇pattern， 而唔係單純睇總日數。例如缺勤頻率、缺勤持續時間、反覆缺勤， 以及缺勤時間模式。例如一個員工一年請一次十日病假， 同另一個員工一年請八次、每次一兩日， 所反映嘅情況可能完全唔同。星期一或者星期五反覆缺勤、 public holiday前後突然增加、更表更改之後出現缺勤、OT 增加之後短期病假上升， 又或者restructure之後成個team開始出現模式性缺 勤，全部都可以成為進一步調查嘅訊號。 建議嘅做法，係將缺勤數據同加班、員工流失、員工投入度、 員工申訴、工作表現及事故報告等資料交叉分析， 再睇吓有冇共同趨勢。當幾個完全唔同嘅資料來源， 都指向同一個部門、經理或者工作流程， 咁就有理由懷疑背後可能存在 心理社會風險。 而澳洲現時嘅WHS框架， 已經唔再將心理健康完全當成員工個人問題。 Psychosocial hazards包括過重嘅工作負荷、職責及角色不清、缺乏支援、 工作場所衝突、管理不善嘅組織變革、 欺凌及騷擾以及低程度嘅工作自主權等。呢啲因素亦可以互相疊加。 例如工作量大本身未必一定造成傷害，但如果同時人手不足、 管理層支援不足、員工缺乏主權， 再加上公司正進行restructure，風險自然會增加。 當企業發現異常缺勤模式，下一步就唔好問員工：「 你係咪有mental health問題？」咁就梗係死硬啦。 比較適當嘅方法係由工作情況開始。 經理可以同員工進行一次正常嘅出席或者員工身心健康對話
levels.text_en: It turns out that not coming to work could actually be a signal of a mental health issue? Sedgwick Health Solutions recently published the '2026 Mental Health Absence in Australia: Trends, Costs and Compliance Guide,' which raises a thought-provoking point: absence records can serve as an early warning signal for identifying psychosocial hazards. In other words, sick leave itself may not be the problem, but the pattern of sick leave may reflect that something is already wrong in the workplace. Of course, absence data alone cannot prove that an employee has a mental health problem, and certainly cannot by itself determine that a specific workplace hazard caused an employee's illness. However, absence records can serve as a signal, to be combined with other data to confirm risk. WorkSafe Victoria recommends that companies look together at absence rate, employee turnover, exit interviews, employee engagement, incident reports, and workers' compensation claims, rather than looking at just one number. For example, if a company's overall absence rate rises from 3.2% to 3.5%, looking at this number alone may not seem special. But if you break it down further and find that short-term absence in a particular department has increased from twice to four times per person per year, while overtime has increased, employee turnover has risen, and employee surveys also show declining scores for workload and manager support — at this point, it can no longer simply be treated as a few employees 'having more sick days.' The most valuable thing about absence records is actually looking at the pattern, not simply the total number of days. For example: absence frequency, absence duration, recurring absences, and timing patterns of absence. For instance, an employee who takes one ten-day sick leave per year versus another who takes eight leaves of one or two days each per year may reflect completely different situations. Recurring absences on Mondays or Fridays, sudden increases before or after public holidays, absences appearing after shift changes, short-term sick leave rising after overtime increases, or an entire team developing a pattern of absence after a restructure — all of these can be signals warranting further investigation. The recommended approach is to cross-analyze absence data with overtime, employee turnover, employee engagement, employee grievances, performance, and incident reports, to see if there are common trends. When several completely different data sources all point to the same department, manager, or work process, then there is reason to suspect that a psychosocial risk may exist behind it. Australia's current WHS framework no longer treats mental health purely as an individual employee problem. Psychosocial hazards include excessive workload, unclear duties and roles, lack of support, workplace conflict, poorly managed organizational change, bullying and harassment, and low job autonomy. These factors can also stack on top of each other. For example, a heavy workload alone may not necessarily cause harm, but if combined with understaffing, insufficient management support, lack of employee autonomy, and an ongoing restructure, the risk naturally increases. When a company discovers an abnormal absence pattern, the next step should not be to ask the employee: 'Do you have a mental health problem?' — that would obviously backfire. A more appropriate approach is to start from the work situation. Managers can have a normal attendance or wellbeing conversation with the employee.

articles.summary_en: This HR-focused piece discusses a report suggesting that employee absenteeism patterns can serve as early warning signs of psychological/workplace risks, aimed at Australian employers and managers. It draws on guidance from Sedgwick Health Solutions and WorkSafe Victoria about how to interpret absence data responsibly.

articles.title: 隔夜餸加熱無法殺死比細菌更致命的毒素　盤點高危食品及預防方法
articles.summary: 加熱雖然可以殺死好多細菌，但有啲細菌同埋佢哋嘅毒素好耐熱，食咗都可能中毒，所以要小心啲高危食物。

levels.text: 加熱唔可以殺晒所有細菌。有嘅細菌加熱之後都唔會死。佢哋重會整到好耐熱嘅毒素。食咗之後我哋都會中毒。米酵菌酸、肉毒毒素、黃麴黴素都係好危險嘅嘢。剩菜要盡快放入雪櫃，食之前要加熱夠滾，唔好加熱太多次。
levels.text_en: Heating cannot kill all bacteria. Some bacteria don't die even after heating. They can also make toxins that resist heat very well. If we eat these, we can get poisoned. Bongkrekic acid, botulinum toxin, and aflatoxin are all very dangerous things. Leftovers should be put in the fridge as soon as possible, heated thoroughly before eating, and not reheated too many times.

levels.text: 加熱可以殺死大部分細菌，但不能殺死所有細菌。有些細菌十分耐熱，加熱後仍然存活。而且，細菌還會產生毒素，這些毒素同樣耐高温，加熱也不會消失。因此，即使食物經過加熱，仍然有可能引致中毒。常見的危險毒素包括米酵菌酸、肉毒毒素和黃麴黴素，它們分別存在於變質的粉麵、臘肉和發霉的穀物中。這些毒素只需極少分量就能致命，會傷害肝臟、腦部和腎臟等器官。所以，發現食物變色、變味或發霉，應該立即丟棄，不要心疼。剩菜最好盡快冷藏，食用前徹底加熱一次，不要反覆加熱，這樣才安全。
levels.text_en: Heating can kill most bacteria, but not all of them. Some bacteria are very heat-resistant and survive even after heating. Moreover, bacteria can produce toxins that are also heat-resistant and don't disappear with heating. Therefore, even after food is heated, it may still cause poisoning. Common dangerous toxins include bongkrekic acid, botulinum toxin, and aflatoxin, found respectively in spoiled rice noodles, cured meat, and moldy grains. These toxins can be fatal in extremely small amounts and can damage organs such as the liver, brain, and kidneys. So if you notice food has changed color, smell, or gone moldy, you should throw it away immediately rather than feeling it's a waste. It's best to refrigerate leftovers as soon as possible, heat them thoroughly once before eating, and avoid repeated reheating — this is the safe way.

levels.text: 這是個常見誤區。加熱雖能殺滅部分細菌，但無法消除所有細菌（如蠟樣芽孢桿菌、產氣莢膜梭菌）。同時，剩菜剩飯還可能產生各類毒素，一些細菌和毒素對高温有一定的耐受性，食用後仍可能引發中毒。此外，反覆加熱會加速營養流失，所以建議剩菜儘快冷藏，吃前徹底加熱一次，且不宜反覆加熱。 很多人，特別是老一輩的人總有這樣的想法：「剩飯剩菜不怕壞，多加熱就好了，只要加熱温度夠高、時間夠久，管他什麼細菌病毒都會被殺滅，不怕吃壞肚子。」但事實上，這種想法大錯特錯！ 比起細菌本身 它們產生的毒素更要命 首先，剩菜剩飯中要命的，並不只有細菌本身，更為致命的是它們所產生的各類毒素，很多毒素對高温有一定的耐受性。雖然很多時候，加熱確實是一種殺菌的好辦法，畢竟常見的食源性致病菌都不耐高温，但有些時候，就算是殺滅細菌本身，依然會食物中毒。這是因為，讓你中招的不是細菌本身，而是它的「衍生品」。 1. 米酵菌酸 近年來頻頻登上熱搜的米酵菌酸是一種耐高温的毒素。它是唐菖蒲伯克霍爾德菌椰毒致病變種的有毒代謝產物，能耐受120℃高温。唐菖蒲伯克霍爾德氏菌在自然環境中分佈廣泛，發酵食品（比如涼皮）和泡發食品（比如木耳）在高温潮濕的天氣下，容易產生米酵菌酸毒素。 米酵菌酸中毒主要影響肝臟、腦、腎等重要器官，只需1毫克即可致命。簡單來說就是，被米酵菌酸污染的涼皮米粉，就算加熱食用，依然會導致中毒。 2. 肉毒毒素 肉毒桿菌是一種厭氧菌，經常出現在奶製品及臘肉等風乾食品裏，甚至在罐頭及密封醃漬食物中還有極強的生存力，是毒性最強的細菌之一。這是因為它在繁殖過程中會分泌肉毒毒素，它屬於一種劇毒的神經毒素，0.00000005克即可致命，中毒死亡率很高。 雖然肉毒毒素在90℃的條件下加熱兩分鐘即可滅殺，但有時候加熱不到位也會讓人中招——比如用微波爐低功率草草加熱幾十秒，看似温熱了，其實沒起到作用。肉毒毒素中毒，最常見症狀為吞嚥困難，視力模糊，言語不清，運動障礙等，嚴重的會導致呼吸肌衰竭麻痹而死亡。 3. 黃麴黴素 黃麴黴毒素是黃麴黴菌屬黃麴黴菌、寄生麴黴菌產生的代謝物，主要污染糧油、油料作物及其製品，比如陳年米麵，花生瓜子等。急性黃麴黴毒素中毒會出現肝損傷，嚴重的出現水腫昏迷以及死亡。 此外，長期攝入小劑量的黃麴黴毒素會造成慢性中毒，導致肝硬化等慢性肝病。同時，黃麴黴素也是目前所知致癌性最強的化學物質。所以，發現米麵變色變味，乾果零食變苦，不要心疼趕緊扔掉，不要想着「煮熟就好了」。 【延伸閱讀】蟲蟲的復仇｜女網紅泰國旅遊試食「昆蟲食品」驚為天人 結局超慘 有些細菌無法被高温殺死 除了細菌的代謝物無法被高温殺滅外，一些細菌和細菌芽孢本身抗高温能力也很強。 1. 蠟樣芽孢桿菌 蠟樣芽孢桿菌廣泛存在於自然界，很多時候會污染食品。25℃～30℃的室温是它最喜歡的繁殖環境，幾乎所有種類的食物都會受其污染。蠟樣芽孢桿菌中毒會引起嘔
levels.text_en: This is a common misconception. While heating can kill some bacteria, it cannot eliminate all of them (such as Bacillus cereus and Clostridium perfringens). At the same time, leftover food may produce various toxins, and some bacteria and toxins have a degree of heat tolerance, so eating them can still cause poisoning even after heating. In addition, repeated reheating speeds up nutrient loss, so it's recommended to refrigerate leftovers as soon as possible, heat them thoroughly once before eating, and avoid reheating repeatedly. Many people, especially the older generation, believe: 'Leftovers won't spoil — just heat them enough, and as long as the temperature is high enough and long enough, any bacteria or virus will be killed, so there's no worry about stomach upset.' But in fact, this idea is seriously wrong. More deadly than the bacteria themselves are the toxins they produce. First, what's truly dangerous in leftovers isn't just the bacteria themselves, but the various toxins they produce, many of which have some tolerance to high heat. Although heating is often a good way to kill bacteria — since common foodborne pathogens are generally not heat-resistant — in some cases, even after the bacteria themselves are killed, food poisoning can still occur. This is because what makes you sick isn't the bacteria itself, but its 'byproduct.' 1. Bongkrekic acid: This toxin, which has frequently made headlines in recent years, is highly heat-resistant. It is a toxic metabolic product of the coconut-poisoning pathogenic variant of Burkholderia gladioli, and can withstand temperatures up to 120°C. Burkholderia gladioli is widely distributed in nature, and fermented foods (like rice noodle rolls) and soaked foods (like wood ear fungus) can easily produce bongkrekic acid in hot, humid weather. Bongkrekic acid poisoning mainly affects vital organs like the liver, brain, and kidneys, and just 1 milligram can be fatal. Simply put, rice noodles contaminated with bongkrekic acid will still cause poisoning even if reheated before eating. 2. Botulinum toxin: Clostridium botulinum is an anaerobic bacterium often found in dairy products and air-dried foods like cured meat, and it can survive extremely well even in canned or sealed pickled foods — making it one of the most toxic bacteria. This is because during reproduction it secretes botulinum toxin, an extremely potent neurotoxin — just 0.00000005 grams can be fatal, with a very high mortality rate. Although botulinum toxin can be destroyed by heating at 90°C for two minutes, sometimes insufficient heating still leads to poisoning — for example, heating briefly at low power in a microwave for just a few dozen seconds may make food seem warm without actually being effective. Common symptoms of botulinum toxin poisoning include difficulty swallowing, blurred vision, slurred speech, and movement disorders; severe cases can lead to death from respiratory muscle paralysis and failure. 3. Aflatoxin: Aflatoxin is a metabolite produced by Aspergillus flavus and Aspergillus parasiticus, mainly contaminating grains, oils, oil crops and their products, such as old rice and flour, peanuts, and sunflower seeds. Acute aflatoxin poisoning causes liver damage, and severe cases can lead to edema, coma, and death. In addition, long-term intake of small doses of aflatoxin can cause chronic poisoning, leading to chronic liver diseases such as cirrhosis. Aflatoxin is also currently known to be the most carcinogenic chemical substance. So if you notice rice or flour changing color or smell, or dried fruit and snacks turning bitter, don't hesitate — throw them away immediately, and don't think 'cooking it will be fine.' [Further reading] Revenge of the Bugs: A female internet celebrity tries 'insect food' in Thailand, amazed by the taste — but the ending was tragic. Some bacteria cannot be killed by high heat: Besides bacterial metabolites that can't be destroyed by heat, some bacteria and bacterial spores themselves are also highly heat-resistant. 1. Bacillus cereus: Bacillus cereus is widely present in nature and often contaminates food. Room temperature of 25–30°C is its favorite environment for reproduction, and almost all types of food can be contaminated by it. Bacillus cereus poisoning can cause vomit[text cuts off here]
